title: The Unquiet: They Ate the Bread

objectives.text: Hear the spirit of Goodwife Harrow
says: Oh! A visitor. You will take something? I've a loaf just out. The children had theirs already. They were so hungry.
It was good flour. From Andorhal, the same as always. I remember thinking it was a little grey. But it was dear that year, and you do not throw away bread.
They went to sleep so quiet. And then they got up. And I... someone has the oven still lit, up at the field. I can smell it. Please. Put it out.

texts.details:
Go north now, into what was Lordaeron. I have put this one off as long as I could.

South of the town of Andorhal, on Sorrow Hill, there is the spirit of a farmer's wife. Andorhal was the granary of that whole kingdom; every village's flour passed through it. A necromancer's cult poisoned the grain there. She baked with it.

Hear her, $N. She does not fully know what happened. Then go north-west to Felstone Field. The Scourge keeps a cauldron there, brewing the same plague still, and a thing that tends it. She can smell it. That is what holds her.
texts.objectives: Hear the spirit of Goodwife Harrow on Sorrow Hill in the Western Plaguelands and destroy the Cauldron's Tender at Felstone Field. Return to High Priestess Laurena at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind.
texts.progress: She will offer you bread. Do not let her see what that does to you.
texts.completion:
It is out, and she is gone? Thank you. I could not have borne to do that one myself.

I have no lesson for it. There is none. She did nothing wrong. She fed her children. If you take anything from it, take this: when those beside you fall, it will not be because they deserved to. Do not waste your strength asking why. Spend it on whoever is still standing.

You will find, now, that when a companion goes down near you, something comes back to you for the rest.

Sixty seasons. There is one more.

idea: The Unquiet, level 50: a family of Andorhal. From the wiki: Andorhal was the grain distribution centre of northern Lordaeron, where Kel'Thuzad's cult infected the grain; the lich Araj oversees the plague cauldrons of the Western Plaguelands. Gives the perk of mana returning when a companion falls. Invented: Goodwife Harrow and the Cauldron's Tender.
